name: copilot-speedometer
displayName: Copilot Speedometer - tok/s for Copilot Chat
description: Status bar and dashboard showing tokens/second, latency and token usage for every GitHub Copilot Chat request, parsed from the local Copilot debug logs.

copilotSpeedometer.enabled.description: Scan Copilot debug logs in the background and show the tokens/sec status bar item.

copilotSpeedometer.statusBar.description: Show the tokens/sec item in the status bar.

copilotSpeedometer.logPath.description: Override the Copilot debug-logs root directory (the folder that contains the per-session subfolders with main.jsonl). Leave empty to auto-detect VS Code / Insiders / VSCodium / Cursor.

copilotSpeedometer.pollIntervalMs.description: How often to check the log files for new requests, in milliseconds.

copilotSpeedometer.historySize.description: Maximum number of requests kept in memory.

copilotSpeedometer.backfillDays.description: On startup, load requests from log files modified within this many days (0 disables backfill).

copilotSpeedometer.includeLegacyWorkspac.description: Also scan the legacy workspaceStorage/<hash>/GitHub.copilot-chat/debug-logs layout used by older VS Code versions.

copilotSpeedometer.usageEvents.description: Also read the Copilot agent usage records (~/.copilot/session-state/*/events.jsonl). These cover BYOK / custom-endpoint models and carry TTFT, and do not require debug logging.

copilotSpeedometer.usageEventsRoot.description: Override the Copilot agent session-state directory. Leave empty to use ~/.copilot/session-state.
